subject: Daral
fact: Daral was cured of sickness by Dawnbringer, regained full health, and immediately began obsessively researching magical swords with sentience and beauty, declaring it his life’s new subject.
source_quote: I shall do all kinds of new research on magical swords, with the sentience and the beauty of Dawnbringer. I intend to make it an area of active research.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wielded Dawnbringer in combat against helmed horrors, used its sap ability to disrupt enemy movement, and spent stored tactical tricks to correct missed strikes when geometry demanded it.
source_quote: Alright — let's go ahead and attack. With Dawnbringer... This is good — let's do it again.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir identified helmed horrors as animated armor with hovering motion and glowing eyes, attempted verbal engagement, and used physical strikes to subdue them, aided by Glabbagool’s acid attack.
source_quote: Seems like it's a helmed horror? Is this, like, animated armor or something?... You're a popular guy!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was targeted by helmed horrors, evaded a fatal grab, initially misapplied mind-affecting spells, then switched to Scorching Ray to damage their armor, demonstrating adaptability in combat.
source_quote: Alright — we're going to try Scorching Ray.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum stood in the path of a helmed horror, was shoved aside without effect, and later unleashed a burst of clean light that affected two horrors simultaneously.
source_quote: Grygum stepped up and let go a burst of clean light that caught two of them at once, both flinching under it.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris was stunned by the sudden appearance of helmed horrors and was rendered incapacitated by Thorin to remove him from tactical consideration.
source_quote: Fembris just stood in shock. I clocked both of them and put them out of my head.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, riding Zalthir’s arm, performed an acid attack that dissolved helmed horror armor, consuming a piece of it entirely.
source_quote: Glabbagool — riding his arm — did the acid trick. Plate hissed and ran.

subject: helmed horror
fact: Helmed horrors were animated suits of plate armor with hovering motion, glowing eye-like lights, and no sentience — driven solely by objective-based programming, impervious to verbal persuasion, and vulnerable to fire and acid.
source_quote: Suits of plate with nobody inside, walking and — this was the part that made my neck itch — hovering, lifting a hand's width off the floor and drifting. Little points of light where eyes should be.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient magical sword that absorbs praise and recognition, responds to its wielder’s intent, and possesses a sap ability that slows and disrupts enemy movement.
source_quote: Dawnbringer eats it up, I'm sure... a sword that spends its days pointed at fungus and undead, being told at length that it is beautiful, that it is worthy of study — I watched the whole demeanor of the thing open up.

subject: ambush of the helmed horrors
fact: A sudden, three-directional ambush by helmed horrors occurred in Deneir's office, forcing the party into immediate combat after a moment of stunned inaction, resulting in coordinated use of fire, acid, light, and sword-sap to defeat the creatures.
source_quote: Glass and wood came in at the same time, from three directions, and for a breath none of us had moved.

subject: Deneir's office
fact: Deneir's office was the site of the party’s prolonged confinement, the healing of Daral, and the ambush by helmed horrors — a place of bureaucratic stillness suddenly shattered by violent intrusion.
source_quote: So we sat in Deneir's office, fed by proxy, our patient healed, wondering how the story was going to end.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a named magical sword that glows when activated, delivers precise strikes, and possesses an internal sap ability that disrupts enemy motion — it is sentient and responds to emotional validation.
source_quote: The blade lit, poured into Daral, and took the sickness with it... Dawnbringer, do your thing.

subject: locked door
fact: The party’s escape was blocked by a locked door in Deneir’s office, trapping them during Daral’s healing and again during the helmed horror ambush — a persistent narrative obstacle hinting at external control or impending escalation.
source_quote: Then Daral, glowing and cured and full of research, rose to leave — and found the door still locked. He was not going anywhere. None of us were.

subject: session date
fact: The events described occurred during a single, continuous session following the restoration of Daral and preceding the ambush — a narrative arc spanning healing, revelation, and sudden violence.
source_quote: Then Daral... rose to leave — and found the door still locked... Combat? Zalthir said. Yes. Combat.
